items.question: How do Indian pharma companies find distributors and buyers abroad?
items.answer: By shortlisting partners whose portfolio and customer coverage match your range, then reaching their business development and sourcing heads with your regulatory credentials up front. One formulation company shortlisted 3 UAE distributors from 12 partner meetings, and an API manufacturer held 16 sourcing meetings with US buyers evaluating a second supplier.

items.question: Does Myntmore handle regulatory approvals or compliance for us?
items.answer: No. Myntmore is a B2B outbound lead generation partner, we find and book meetings with the right buyers. Regulatory approvals, WHO-GMP or USFDA certification processes, and import-export compliance are handled entirely by your own regulatory, quality, and compliance team. We do not advise on or claim expertise in these areas.

items.question: How does outreach differ for domestic buyers versus export and global buyers?
items.answer: Domestic outreach targets hospital purchase committees, distributors, and chemist chains, with messaging built around tender cycles and regional buying patterns. Export and contract-manufacturing outreach targets importers, sourcing heads, and procurement teams abroad, with messaging built around therapeutic category fit and manufacturing capacity. We run both as separate, tailored tracks.

items.question: How do you handle compliance-sensitive messaging in outreach?
items.answer: We reference certifications and manufacturing capability factually, stating what you hold and what your facility supports, without making regulatory claims on your behalf. Every sequence is approved by your team before it goes out, and any compliance question a buyer raises is flagged and routed straight to you.

items.question: Which buyer titles and roles do you typically target?
items.answer: Procurement heads, regulatory affairs contacts, import and export managers, hospital purchase committee members and distribution partners. The mix depends on whether the target account is domestic or export focused: export campaigns lean towards sourcing and regulatory roles, while domestic ones lean towards hospital procurement and distributors.

items.question: How fast will we start seeing meetings?
items.answer: Most pharma clients see their first qualified buyer conversations within 3 to 5 weeks, once ICP mapping, list building and outreach sequences are in place. Export campaigns can take longer to convert, because buyers usually ask for documentation, samples or audits before moving to a commercial discussion.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
